name: What should I do to prepare my home for drywall repair work?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home for drywall repair work?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your home for drywall repair, we recommend clearing the repair area by moving furniture and other belongings away from the walls. Covering nearby items with drop cloths or plastic sheeting can also help protect them from dust, as sanding is often part of the process. While our team takes precautions to minimize dust and disruption, these steps help ensure a smoother and more efficient repair process. If the repair is in an active living space, discuss optimal timing with us to reduce inconvenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture from the area and cover nearby items to protect them from dust during the repair.
